evidence_class: Real ledger HTTP server in process in remote deployment mode, real SQLite ledger repository, fakeredis hive membership, subprocess worker CLI with a read-only home. Live G3 qualification is separate.
interfaces: ledger.call routes remote deployments through remote_call; a transport failure never reads the local repository or starts a ledger server
ledger.retried(read, attempts) retries outages and 5xx answers for reads (REMOTE_READ_ATTEMPTS 3, pauses 0.5 s then 1 s); writes run once
ledger.resource and ledger.export use the same bounded retry when remote and build credentials and the client on every attempt

ledger.Unauthenticated (SystemExit) with 'unauthenticated: <reason>' for a missing launch token, a missing pinned identity, a 401/403 hive credential refusal and a server 403 'Missing or wrong ledger credential'
ledger.REQUEST_TIMEOUT 10 s for every remote ResourceClient (request, resource, export, launch token)
Local deployment keeps the page token lookup and the server autostart

supported_versions.python: 3.11 and 3.12 unit shards in the linked CI run
supported_versions.server: Existing ledger HTTP API v1 with hive agent tokens (scripts.hive.auth.issue_agent)
supported_versions.endpoint: LEDGER_URL with AGENTIHOOKS_DEPLOYMENT other than local
supported_versions.credential: AGENTIHOOKS_LEDGER_AGENT_TOKEN from the launch configuration, or AGENTIHOOKS_HIVE_LEDGER_CREDENTIAL to derive it
supported_versions.compatibility: Local mode behaviour is covered by the existing ledger authority and remote client tests

states.observed: Worker subprocess stdout and exit code, ledger revision, task comments read from the SQLite repository
states.accepted: Server accepts the hive-token write bound to slug and agent; refuses the same token under another agent label
states.committed: Comment present once in the authoritative SQLite ledger after a lost response and two replays of the same op id
states.externally_verified: Not claimed; live G3 evidence is required at the rollout gate

validation.red: https://github.com/the-cloud-clockwork/agentihooks/actions/runs/37934009539 failed all nine new tests on the tests-only commit ad291bb4
validation.review: Standards reader closed in round 3, Spec reader closed in round 2
validation.local: No local tests or mutation ran; static prepush passed on 42a01505
validation.unit: All unit shards passed on 42a01505; each acceptance case passed twice from independent fixture homes

measurements.dimension: Per worker process; each acceptance case reads its own subprocess or a before and after delta in process

rollback_rehearsal.action: Set AGENTIHOOKS_DEPLOYMENT=local: the page token lookup and server autostart return, LEDGER_URL is ignored
rollback_rehearsal.authoritative_objects: SQLite ledger repository and its page token; hive membership and agent token records in Redis. Rollback deletes neither.

failure_evidence: The first mutation preflight run 37934215314 failed the recovery case with 403 because a remote-mode server refuses HMAC agent tokens; the fixture now derives a hive token. Smallest reproducer: tests/sv2_ldg01_cases.py recovery with an HMAC token.
remaining_limitations: Live G3 deployment evidence is required at the rollout gate; these are mocked fixtures
The auth failure counter is per process and has no exporter
A worker given LEDGER_URL without AGENTIHOOKS_DEPLOYMENT still runs local; changing that default is a ledger follow-up for the operator
The server-not-answering hint in ledger_link.page_line still names the local start command
